properties.feihou_h3_prompt_preview_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 悟空 (S1), the young monkey-king male singer in <Picture 1> (SC1): golden-brown facial fur, sharp golden eyes, a gold dragon-pattern crown over black hair, a golden flame mark on the forehead, gold-red brocade stage armor with cloud-and-dragon embroidery, bronze chainmail shoulder plates, dark red collar, a deep red cloud-pattern cape, holding a gold dragon-carved vintage microphone.
<Picture 1> (SC1) is the rendered plate for "悟空歌手角色卡(东方奇幻·九天云海)": front-facing half-body portrait of 悟空 over rolling golden clouds, warm gold key light and cool blue rim light, distant celestial-palace silhouette.
<Picture 2> (SC2) is the rendered plate for "悟空主舞台演唱(东方奇幻·悬浮仙山)": the floating mountain arena, a rotating golden lotus-array stage, a gilded dragon-coiled pillar, nine-heaven palace silhouette, sea of star-fire glow sticks.
<Audio 1> is the warm gravelly male vocal of <Subject 1> (S1); this segment uses the A1 track only as an underlay ambience, not for lip-sync.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 9.00-second MiniMax H3 generation unit from the AI music-show 《音乐封神榜》, the 《再回首》 full episode, H3-006, 段② 开场包装. The unit draws on the rendered plates SC1, SC2 (<Picture 1>, <Picture 2>) and uses <Audio 1> only as stage ambience; no direct audio reuse for dialogue.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved - keep 悟空's identity anchors: golden-brown fur, dragon-pattern crown, golden flame mark, gold-red brocade armor, deep red cloud cape, gold dragon microphone.
<Picture 2>: fully_preserved - keep the floating mountain arena, rotating golden lotus-array stage, gilded dragon-coiled pillar, nine-heaven palace silhouette and star-fire audience.
<Audio 1>: weak_reference - only the general vocal texture of the A1 track lingers as stage ambience; the segment carries no lip-synced singing.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] The floating mountain arena, now fully lit, with the golden lotus-array stage glowing beneath. 悟空 (S1), the monkey-king singer from <Picture {pic_map['SC1']}>, steps forward onto the center of the lotus array in one stride, raises the gold dragon microphone, scans the cloud-sea audience and speaks the rally line with a warm, gravelly voice: <d>[Chinese] 俺老孙,来讨一个公道。</d> The lotus-array golden light flares fully; the camera pushes in slowly from a medium shot toward his face, ending on a stable terminal frame.

overall_soundscape:
Rolling cloud-sea ambience with a low divine hum and the distant roar of the star-fire audience; the faint tail of <Audio 1> lingers as a soft underlay.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A.
